phase-plan.purpose: Continue shrinking `game.ts` by moving history, dialogue-progress recording, quest/archetype refresh, and global-event processing into dedicated runtime system modules so `GameEngine` becomes orchestration instead of a monolith.
phase-plan.scope: In scope: history/event recording, dialogue-progress tracking, quest updates, archetype refresh, and global-event processing. Out of scope: NPC policy/hostile simulation extraction and the remaining deed/rumor subsystem cleanup.

file.description: Main composition root that should now delegate history/progression work into dedicated systems.
New system seam for dialogue progress, chapter pages, event recording, and cutscene event recording.
New system seam for quest progress, archetype refresh, and global-event processing.
Architecture doc that should describe the new `engine/systems/*` seam ownership.

task.description: Extract history/event recording and dialogue-progress tracking into `engine/systems/history.ts`.
Extract quest progression, archetype refresh, and global-event processing into `engine/systems/progression.ts`.
Finish the remaining 62-03 follow-through by extracting deed/rumor history and then NPC/hostile simulation out of `game.ts` before calling the orchestration phase clean.

decision.summary: Event recording and dialogue-progress tracking are low-risk extraction seams because they mostly mutate state and do not own combat or action availability rules.
decision.impact: The engine gets smaller without destabilizing turn resolution.

decision.summary: Quest/archetype/global-event logic belongs in a progression seam rather than remaining mixed into action execution and room-turn plumbing.
decision.impact: `GameEngine` can orchestrate turn flow while the progression system owns progression bookkeeping.
